_comment: District 10 (GDD §4.1 chain order), ACT III (GDD §12.3: D9-11) — and the POINT OF NO RETURN is entering it (GDD §12.3). data/districts/district_substation.tres powered_by = [&"industrial"] — GDD §4.3 requires the prerequisite at FULL, so the guaranteed closure is industrial's six-district union PLUS industrial itself: suburbs, residential, park, hospital, warehouses, police, industrial (seven districts, all stages). NOT guaranteed: school, gas_station (leaves), power_station (descendant — radio_03 stays out). This is the first district where radio_02_grid_crew_relay (substation / min_stage 1) is legal. Threat roster (scripts/enemies/enemy_pool.gd): destroyer, watcher, hunter — DESTROYER leads for the second district running: no light reaction at all AND it breaks nearby streetlights on patrol (destroyer_3d.gd), so light stays a spent consumable, never a tool (R5). Watcher takes the corridor (2 s beam-stun, then rage x1.25 / 5 s, 15 m scream pulls the yard); hunter holds the trench (beam slows x0.5, rage x1.3 / 5 s the instant the beam leaves). Themed loot canon (district_loot.gd BY_DISTRICT): fuse, cable, transistor — the whole repair chain IS the theme here; the fixed spawns mirror district_loot.gd REPAIR_PARTS (2x cable/fuse/transistor). Story doc canon: doc_substation_guard ('welded door opened by itself at 03:00, darkness on the threshold, logged as a sensor trip') — extended, never copied, by substation_note_01 (the guard's duplicate logbook). Blueprint CANON: district_loot.gd BLUEPRINTS has NO substation row — exactly four blueprint districts (residential/park/police/warehouses); GDD §9 lists no D10 craft — R7. Puzzle canon: puzzle_system.gd fuse_substation (reward coins 200, power_stage 2). All item ids verified against data/items/*.tres (41 ids, 2026-09).

fixed_spawns.reason: Guarantee: cable for PARTIAL. Drum cable on the relay-room spool rack, open from the control corridor; feeder cable is what this building is.
Guarantee: fuse for STREETS. The mimic-board wall cabinet — rack fuses under the board that drew its own route (substation_note_04). The cabinet the crew did not need to force.

Guarantee: transistor for FULL. The vault's solid-state spares, racked beside breaker 9 ('breaker 9, wired off-plan' — substation_note_05). Vault locked; opened by substation_fix_key_01 — no lockpick required (R1).
Vault key in the control-room desk drawer, unlocked — the night operator's drawer, same discipline as the industrial foreman's desk. Reachable in DARK with zero tools (R1).
Battery top-up on arrival; the gatehouse is the district's safe pocket past the point of no return, and the yard beyond it is destroyer ground in fog.
Themed guarantee: a whole spare transformer unit staged in the boneyard parts bin — one of the Keeper's eastbound pieces (substation_note_06). Non-chain, non-RNG by R6.
Themed guarantee: relay-rack wire stock — the sender rack's own spares, beside the recovered tape (substation_note_07).
Optional risk-reward salvage: yard offcuts in the frost drum — deliberately inside the destroyer's patrol (R5), never chain-critical, never required by any rule.
The crew's own first-aid locker, left stocked — Marat's standing order (substation_note_03): the cache is for whoever walks the line next.

Fixed defense cache: the gatehouse compressed-air horn test canisters (noise_bomb, STREETS+ — R2). Fire discipline keeps them out of the relay room, the vault and the arc cage (R8); the yard is oil-filled breakers and open busbars.

rules: R1: In DARK, fixed_spawns alone must cover the repair chain (>=2 cable, >=2 fuse, >=2 transistor): cable on the relay-room spool, fuse in the control-room cabinet, transistor in the vault relay rack; the vault key (substation_fix_key_01) sits in the control room's unlocked desk drawer, so the whole chain is reachable with zero lockpicks and zero rolled loot. None of the three chain components or the key sits in the destroyer's patrol (transformer yard / boneyard edge) — a player who never fights it still finishes.

R2: Rolled loot never includes stage-gated items early: table lookup uses the CURRENT DistrictData.Stage only. fuse and transistor never roll in DARK (the control cabinet and the vault rack are the DARK sources); molotov enters rolls at PARTIAL, noise_bomb at STREETS — mirroring the industrial/warehouses/police discipline.
R3: Fixed spawns are one-time per save; rolls are per-container with container_modifiers on qty.

R4: No firearms in substation. There is no pistol/rifle/ammo id in data/items. molotov/noise_bomb remain the combat ceiling; the district pays out the repair chain itself (fuse/cable/transistor per BY_DISTRICT) and lets the fuse_substation puzzle pay coins (puzzle_system.gd) — parts, not medicine.

R5: DESTROYER-LEADS for the second district running (enemy_pool.gd [destroyer, watcher, hunter]) — light is still not even a disengage tool: the destroyer has NO light reaction and BREAKS nearby streetlights while patrolling (destroyer_3d.gd), so every lamp is a consumable the district eats; its cue is the machinery hum audible at 12 m and its weakness is the 5 m / 180-degree sight — cover is transformer-tank spacing, not beams. The watcher takes the relay/control corridor: 2 s beam-stun, then rage x1.25 for 5 s, breath audible at 5 m, 15 m scream pulls the whole yard. The hunter holds the cable trench: beam slows x0.5, then rage x1.3 for 5 s the instant the beam leaves it (never strobe-and-run). The DARK chain (R1) never requires light, combat or a chase.

R6: Scripted caches must not roll empty: the relay spool, the fuse cabinet, the control desk, the vault rack, the bunk locker and the gatehouse crate are fixed payouts (mirrors industrial switchgear/desk/bins/crate).

R7: No blueprint in substation: district_loot.gd BLUEPRINTS canon is exactly four districts (residential, park, police, warehouses) — substation is not one of them, and GDD §9 lists no D10 craft (same class as industrial's D9 Battery L2 location flavour). No schematic id may roll or fix-spawn here.

R8: z_switchgear_vault never relights at any stage (windowless and locked; read by corridor spill — mirrors industrial switchgear, police holding cells, warehouses quarantine cage): no streetlight_3d inside, global relight passes must skip it. z_arc_cage never relights and is NEVER ENTERED at any stage — the fence stays locked with no key anywhere (examined through the mesh only); the cage is the district's anomaly (the fault that arcs), not wallpaper, and must never become a sound cue beyond its district_atmosphere detail bed. Fire discipline: no molotov/noise_bomb cache inside z_relay_room (sender rack), z_switchgear_vault or z_arc_cage (oil-filled breakers, open busbars) — the district's fixed defense cache is the gatehouse air-horn canister.
